description: This file contains hooks and utility functions for customizing MkDocs documentation build process, including handling translations, resolving files, and modifying navigation and markdown content.

classes.name: EnFile
classes.description: A subclass of mkdocs.structure.files.File, possibly for custom handling of files in the documentation build.

methods.name: get_missing_translation_content
methods.description: Reads and returns the content of the missing translation markdown file based on the docs directory.

methods.name: get_translation_banner_content
methods.description: Reads and returns the translation banner markdown content, falling back to a default path if not found.

methods.name: get_mkdocs_material_langs
methods.description: Returns a list of available language codes based on the material templates directory.

methods.name: on_config
methods.description: Adjusts MkDocs configuration based on the language detected from the docs directory.

methods.name: resolve_file
methods.description: Resolves a file path, adding it to the files list, with fallback to an English source directory.

methods.name: resolve_files
methods.description: Resolves multiple files or directories specified in a list, handling nested structures.

methods.name: on_files
methods.description: Processes the files list, resolving theme logos, favicons, CSS, and JS files.

methods.name: generate_renamed_section_items
methods.description: Recursively processes navigation sections to modify titles and collapse sections by default.

methods.name: on_nav
methods.description: Modifies the navigation structure for the documentation site.

methods.name: on_page_markdown
methods.description: Modifies markdown content for translation banners and metadata, based on page and file type.
